blocks.source: Canto III
blocks.translation: Canto III

blocks.source: ‘Per me si va ne la città dolente,
blocks.translation: “Through me the way is to the city dolent;

blocks.source: per me si va ne l’etterno dolore,
blocks.translation: Through me the way is to eternal dole;

blocks.source: per me si va tra la perduta gente.
blocks.translation: Through me the way among the people lost.

blocks.source: Giustizia mosse il mio alto fattore;
blocks.translation: Justice incited my sublime Creator;

blocks.source: fecemi la divina podestate,
blocks.translation: Created me divine Omnipotence,

blocks.source: la somma sapïenza e ’l primo amore.
blocks.translation: The highest Wisdom and the primal Love.

blocks.source: Dinanzi a me non fuor cose create
blocks.translation: Before me there were no created things,

blocks.source: se non etterne, e io etterno duro.
blocks.translation: Only eterne, and I eternal last.

blocks.source: Lasciate ogne speranza, voi ch’intrate’.
blocks.translation: All hope abandon, ye who enter in!”

blocks.source: Queste parole di colore oscuro
blocks.translation: These words in sombre colour I beheld

blocks.source: vid’ ïo scritte al sommo d’una porta;
blocks.translation: Written upon the summit of a gate;

blocks.source: per ch’io: «Maestro, il senso lor m’è duro».
blocks.translation: Whence I: “Their sense is, Master, hard to me!”

blocks.source: Ed elli a me, come persona accorta:
blocks.translation: And he to me, as one experienced:

blocks.source: «Qui si convien lasciare ogne sospetto;
blocks.translation: “Here all suspicion needs must be abandoned,

blocks.source: ogne viltà convien che qui sia morta.
blocks.translation: All cowardice must needs be here extinct.

blocks.source: Noi siam venuti al loco ov’ i’ t’ho detto
blocks.translation: We to the place have come, where I have told thee

blocks.source: che tu vedrai le genti dolorose
blocks.translation: Thou shalt behold the people dolorous

blocks.source: c’hanno perduto il ben de l’intelletto».
blocks.translation: Who have foregone the good of intellect.”

blocks.source: E poi che la sua mano a la mia puose
blocks.translation: And after he had laid his hand on mine

blocks.source: con lieto volto, ond’ io mi confortai,
blocks.translation: With joyful mien, whence I was comforted,

blocks.source: mi mise dentro a le segrete cose.
blocks.translation: He led me in among the secret things.

blocks.source: Quivi sospiri, pianti e alti guai
blocks.translation: There sighs, complaints, and ululations loud

blocks.source: risonavan per l’aere sanza stelle,
blocks.translation: Resounded through the air without a star,

blocks.source: per ch’io al cominciar ne lagrimai.
blocks.translation: Whence I, at the beginning, wept thereat.

blocks.source: Diverse lingue, orribili favelle,
blocks.translation: Languages diverse, horrible dialects,

blocks.source: parole di dolore, accenti d’ira,
blocks.translation: Words of sorrow, accents of anger,

blocks.source: voci alte e fioche, e suon di man con elle
blocks.translation: And voices high and hoarse, with sound of hands,

blocks.source: facevano un tumulto, il qual s’aggira
blocks.translation: Made up a tumult that goes whirling on

blocks.source: sempre in quell’ aura sanza tempo tinta,
blocks.translation: For ever in that air for ever black,

blocks.source: come la rena quando turbo spira.
blocks.translation: Even as the sand doth, when the whirlwind breathes.

blocks.source: E io ch’avea d’error la testa cinta,
blocks.translation: And I, who had my head with horror bound,

blocks.source: dissi: «Maestro, che è quel ch’i’ odo?
blocks.translation: Said: “Master, what is this which now I hear?

blocks.source: e che gent’ è che par nel duol sì vinta?».
blocks.translation: What folk is this, which seems by pain so vanquished?”

blocks.source: Ed elli a me: «Questo misero modo
blocks.translation: And he to me: “This miserable mode

blocks.source: tegnon l’anime triste di coloro
blocks.translation: Maintain the melancholy souls of those

blocks.source: che visser sanza ’nfamia e sanza lodo.
blocks.translation: Who lived withouten infamy or praise.

blocks.source: Mischiate sono a quel cattivo coro
blocks.translation: Commingled are they with that caitiff choir

blocks.source: de li angeli che non furon ribelli
blocks.translation: Of Angels, who have not rebellious been,

blocks.source: né fur fedeli a Dio, ma per sé fuoro.
blocks.translation: Nor faithful were to God, but were for self.

blocks.source: Caccianli i ciel per non esser men belli,
blocks.translation: The heavens expelled them, not to be less fair;

blocks.source: né lo profondo inferno li riceve,
blocks.translation: Nor them the nethermore abyss receives,

blocks.source: ch’alcuna gloria i rei avrebber d’elli».
blocks.translation: For the wicked would have some glory over them.”

blocks.source: E io: «Maestro, che è tanto greve
blocks.translation: And I: “O Master, what so grievous is

blocks.source: a lor che lamentar li fa sì forte?».
blocks.translation: To these, that maketh them lament so sore?”

blocks.source: Rispuose: «Dicerolti molto breve.
blocks.translation: He answered: “I will tell thee very briefly.

blocks.source: Questi non hanno speranza di morte,
blocks.translation: These have no longer any hope of death;

blocks.source: e la lor cieca vita è tanto bassa,
blocks.translation: And this blind life of theirs is so debased,

blocks.source: che ’nvidïosi son d’ogne altra sorte.
blocks.translation: They envious are of every other fate.

blocks.source: Fama di loro il mondo esser non lassa;
blocks.translation: No fame of them the world permits to be;

blocks.source: misericordia e giustizia li sdegna:
blocks.translation: Misericord and Justice both disdain them.

blocks.source: non ragioniam di lor, ma guarda e passa».
blocks.translation: Let us not speak of them, but look, and pass.”

blocks.source: E io, che riguardai, vidi una ’nsegna
blocks.translation: And I, who looked again, beheld a banner,

blocks.source: che girando correva tanto ratta,
blocks.translation: Which, whirling round, ran on so rapidly,

blocks.source: che d’ogne posa mi parea indegna;
blocks.translation: That of all pause it seemed to me indignant;

blocks.source: e dietro le venìa sì lunga tratta
blocks.translation: And after it there came so long a train

blocks.source: di gente, ch’i’ non averei creduto
blocks.translation: Of people, that I ne’er would have believed

blocks.source: che morte tanta n’avesse disfatta.
blocks.translation: That ever Death so many had undone.

blocks.source: Poscia ch’io v’ebbi alcun riconosciuto,
blocks.translation: When some among them I had recognised,

blocks.source: vidi e conobbi l’ombra di colui
blocks.translation: I looked, and I beheld the shade of him

blocks.source: che fece per viltade il gran rifiuto.
blocks.translation: Who made through cowardice the great refusal.

blocks.source: Incontanente intesi e certo fui
blocks.translation: Forthwith I comprehended, and was certain,

blocks.source: che questa era la setta d’i cattivi,
blocks.translation: That this the sect was of the caitiff wretches

blocks.source: a Dio spiacenti e a’ nemici sui.
blocks.translation: Hateful to God and to his enemies.

blocks.source: Questi sciaurati, che mai non fur vivi,
blocks.translation: These miscreants, who never were alive,

blocks.source: erano ignudi e stimolati molto
blocks.translation: Were naked, and were stung exceedingly

blocks.source: da mosconi e da vespe ch’eran ivi.
blocks.translation: By gadflies and by hornets that were there.

blocks.source: Elle rigavan lor di sangue il volto,
blocks.translation: These did their faces irrigate with blood,

blocks.source: che, mischiato di lagrime, a’ lor piedi
blocks.translation: Which, with their tears commingled, at their feet

blocks.source: da fastidiosi vermi era ricolto.
blocks.translation: By the disgusting worms was gathered up.

blocks.source: E poi ch’a riguardar oltre mi diedi,
blocks.translation: And when to gazing farther I betook me.

blocks.source: vidi genti a la riva d’un gran fiume;
blocks.translation: People I saw on a great river’s bank;

blocks.source: per ch’io dissi: «Maestro, or mi concedi
blocks.translation: Whence said I: “Master, now vouchsafe to me,

blocks.source: ch’i’ sappia quali sono, e qual costume
blocks.translation: That I may know who these are, and what law

blocks.source: le fa di trapassar parer sì pronte,
blocks.translation: Makes them appear so ready to pass over,

blocks.source: com’ i’ discerno per lo fioco lume».
blocks.translation: As I discern athwart the dusky light.”

blocks.source: Ed elli a me: «Le cose ti fier conte
blocks.translation: And he to me: “These things shall all be known

blocks.source: quando noi fermerem li nostri passi
blocks.translation: To thee, as soon as we our footsteps stay

blocks.source: su la trista riviera d’Acheronte».
blocks.translation: Upon the dismal shore of Acheron.”

blocks.source: Allor con li occhi vergognosi e bassi,
blocks.translation: Then with mine eyes ashamed and downward cast,

blocks.source: temendo no ’l mio dir li fosse grave,
blocks.translation: Fearing my words might irksome be to him,

blocks.source: infino al fiume del parlar mi trassi.
blocks.translation: From speech refrained I till we reached the river.

blocks.source: Ed ecco verso noi venir per nave
blocks.translation: And lo! towards us coming in a boat

blocks.source: un vecchio, bianco per antico pelo,
blocks.translation: An old man, hoary with the hair of eld,

blocks.source: gridando: «Guai a voi, anime prave!
blocks.translation: Crying: “Woe unto you, ye souls depraved!

blocks.source: Non isperate mai veder lo cielo:
blocks.translation: Hope nevermore to look upon the heavens;

blocks.source: i’ vegno per menarvi a l’altra riva
blocks.translation: I come to lead you to the other shore,

blocks.source: ne le tenebre etterne, in caldo e ’n gelo.
blocks.translation: To the eternal shades in heat and frost.

blocks.source: E tu che se’ costì, anima viva,
blocks.translation: And thou, that yonder standest, living soul,

blocks.source: pàrtiti da cotesti che son morti».
blocks.translation: Withdraw thee from these people, who are dead!”

blocks.source: Ma poi che vide ch’io non mi partiva,
blocks.translation: But when he saw that I did not withdraw,

blocks.source: disse: «Per altra via, per altri porti
blocks.translation: He said: “By other ways, by other ports

blocks.source: verrai a piaggia, non qui, per passare:
blocks.translation: Thou to the shore shalt come, not here, for passage;

blocks.source: più lieve legno convien che ti porti».
blocks.translation: A lighter vessel needs must carry thee.”

blocks.source: E ’l duca lui: «Caron, non ti crucciare:
blocks.translation: And unto him the Guide: “Vex thee not, Charon;

blocks.source: vuolsi così colà dove si puote
blocks.translation: It is so willed there where is power to do

blocks.source: ciò che si vuole, e più non dimandare».
blocks.translation: That which is willed; and farther question not.”

blocks.source: Quinci fuor quete le lanose gote
blocks.translation: Thereat were quieted the fleecy cheeks

blocks.source: al nocchier de la livida palude,
blocks.translation: Of him the ferryman of the livid fen,

blocks.source: che ’ntorno a li occhi avea di fiamme rote.
blocks.translation: Who round about his eyes had wheels of flame.

blocks.source: Ma quell’ anime, ch’eran lasse e nude,
blocks.translation: But all those souls who weary were and naked

blocks.source: cangiar colore e dibattero i denti,
blocks.translation: Their colour changed and gnashed their teeth together,

blocks.source: ratto che ’nteser le parole crude.
blocks.translation: As soon as they had heard those cruel words.

blocks.source: Bestemmiavano Dio e lor parenti,
blocks.translation: God they blasphemed and their progenitors,

blocks.source: l’umana spezie e ’l loco e ’l tempo e ’l seme
blocks.translation: The human race, the place, the time, the seed

blocks.source: di lor semenza e di lor nascimenti.
blocks.translation: Of their engendering and of their birth!

blocks.source: Poi si ritrasser tutte quante insieme,
blocks.translation: Thereafter all together they drew back,

blocks.source: forte piangendo, a la riva malvagia
blocks.translation: Bitterly weeping, to the accursed shore,

blocks.source: ch’attende ciascun uom che Dio non teme.
blocks.translation: Which waiteth every man who fears not God.

blocks.source: Caron dimonio, con occhi di bragia
blocks.translation: Charon the demon, with the eyes of glede,

blocks.source: loro accennando, tutte le raccoglie;
blocks.translation: Beckoning to them, collects them all together,

blocks.source: batte col remo qualunque s’adagia.
blocks.translation: Beats with his oar whoever lags behind.

blocks.source: Come d’autunno si levan le foglie
blocks.translation: As in the autumn-time the leaves fall off,

blocks.source: l’una appresso de l’altra, fin che ’l ramo
blocks.translation: First one and then another, till the branch

blocks.source: vede a la terra tutte le sue spoglie,
blocks.translation: Unto the earth surrenders all its spoils;

blocks.source: similemente il mal seme d’Adamo
blocks.translation: In similar wise the evil seed of Adam

blocks.source: gittansi di quel lito ad una ad una,
blocks.translation: Throw themselves from that margin one by one,

blocks.source: per cenni come augel per suo richiamo.
blocks.translation: At signals, as a bird unto its lure.

blocks.source: Così sen vanno su per l’onda bruna,
blocks.translation: So they depart across the dusky wave,

blocks.source: e avanti che sien di là discese,
blocks.translation: And ere upon the other side they land,

blocks.source: anche di qua nuova schiera s’auna.
blocks.translation: Again on this side a new troop assembles.

blocks.source: «Figliuol mio», disse ’l maestro cortese,
blocks.translation: “My son,” the courteous Master said to me,

blocks.source: «quelli che muoion ne l’ira di Dio
blocks.translation: “All those who perish in the wrath of God

blocks.source: tutti convegnon qui d’ogne paese;
blocks.translation: Here meet together out of every land;

blocks.source: e pronti sono a trapassar lo rio,
blocks.translation: And ready are they to pass o’er the river,

blocks.source: ché la divina giustizia li sprona,
blocks.translation: Because celestial Justice spurs them on,

blocks.source: sì che la tema si volve in disio.
blocks.translation: So that their fear is turned into desire.

blocks.source: Quinci non passa mai anima buona;
blocks.translation: This way there never passes a good soul;

blocks.source: e però, se Caron di te si lagna,
blocks.translation: And hence if Charon doth complain of thee,

blocks.source: ben puoi sapere omai che ’l suo dir suona».
blocks.translation: Well mayst thou know now what his speech imports.”

blocks.source: Finito questo, la buia campagna
blocks.translation: This being finished, all the dusk champaign

blocks.source: tremò sì forte, che de lo spavento
blocks.translation: Trembled so violently, that of that terror

blocks.source: la mente di sudore ancor mi bagna.
blocks.translation: The recollection bathes me still with sweat.

blocks.source: La terra lagrimosa diede vento,
blocks.translation: The land of tears gave forth a blast of wind,

blocks.source: che balenò una luce vermiglia
blocks.translation: And fulminated a vermilion light,

blocks.source: la qual mi vinse ciascun sentimento;
blocks.translation: Which overmastered in me every sense,

blocks.source: e caddi come l’uom cui sonno piglia.
blocks.translation: And as a man whom sleep hath seized I fell.
